reason: A uniform 21-artist raw cumulative delta is now empirically observable across distinct provider update epochs.
Only one distinct interval has been characterized, so repeatability and interval stability are not yet established.
Raw counts are scale-dependent and must not be promoted directly into a cross-artist score or Product ranking.
No approved mapping exists from ListenBrainz total_listen_count delta to the current Last.fm listeners/playcount score contract.

requirements: observe all 21 canonical artists with exact MusicBrainz MBID identity
require each artist provider last_updated to be newer than its current per-artist epoch captured in the first distinct-epoch receipt
compute second raw all_time.total_listen_count delta from the first distinct-epoch receipt
persist per-artist provider elapsed seconds between the two distinct epochs
do not treat missing or unavailable as zero
do not define a score, weight, normalization, or threshold

questions: Are raw cumulative deltas non-negative and observable for all 21 across a second distinct interval?
Is provider update timing sufficiently coherent to support a time-normalized signal candidate?
Does any candidate rate require explicit new semantics rather than reuse of the Last.fm contract?
